created_prompt:
Please devise a concrete 3 year plan for the following scenario: 
Julie wants to grow her already large online following and publish a cookbook. Her online community watches her content for the quick and healthy recipes. Since she works 4 times a week, she only has 10-20 hours weekly with little budget to spare. 
Please follow two different scenarios, one with a traditional publication of the cookbook and one with a self-publishing approach. Compare both paths regarding the needs of the online community and her time and monetary ressources. I want to see two approachable 3-year plans with summary for a recommendation which path suits her better.
